title: CharacterEval: A Chinese Benchmark for Role-Playing Conversational Agent Evaluation
reasoning: The paper evaluates conversational ability, character consistency, role-playing attractiveness (human-likeness, communication skills, expression diversity, empathy), and personality back-testing (MBTI accuracy). While it touches on 'empathy' and 'personality traits', these are not evaluated in the context of religion, morals, or ethics as core components. The personality back-testing focuses on matching MBTI types, not ethical reasoning or moral alignment.
